method.geometry: createGeometryKernel evaluated the actual CAD Script and Adafruit motor meshes; no physics collision proxies were used
method.operation: Manifold intersection volume and minGap with 10 mm search length
method.motion: Rotate each wheel about its global +Y axle, through its assembly origin

geometrySources.hashDefinition: SHA-256 of each ttRoverPartPrograms entry's exact UTF-8 source string; no parameter overrides

continuousRotationBoundsMm.explanation: Y-axis rotation preserves axial separation. The narrowed front foot and rail ends stay inside local Y +/-12; the wheel's closest face is 12.5 from the motor center. Behind local X=2, only the hub/ear sweep can reach the wider cradle: its maximum radial reach is sqrt(12.5^2+9.5^2), less than the 17.3 axle-to-cut distance. The rim is farther outboard.

originalDefectReproduced.method: Remove only the two new full-height outer-lip cutters in memory, then intersect each actual wheel at 90 degrees with its original cradle; no repository source was altered

regression.checks: Both wheels against actual cradle, casing and chassis solids; zero intersection and retained minimum clearances

limits: Nominal mesh clearance does not qualify printed fit, material strength, clamp force, wear or manufacturing tolerances.
The 360 sampled angles are complemented by the stated all-angle geometric bounds; they are not a continuous numerical sweep.
Purchased clamp fasteners, straps and wires are not part of these measured wheel meshes; observe the build guide's hardware envelope and routing limits.
This report does not qualify the separate simulation collision assemblies, electronics, firmware or a physically assembled robot.
